item.title: When Uniforms Clash: The Jorhat Traffic Incident and Civil-Military Friction
item.dc:creator: Amarjeet Singh
item.description:
A routine traffic stop in Assam's Jorhat district escalated into a civil-military flashpoint after an MVI issued a challan to an Army driver, exposing underlying jurisdictional friction.
[SPLIT] ⚡ District Transport Officer Dhananjay Saikia clarified that the fine was strictly for a seatbelt violation, debunking social media rumors regarding license invalidity. [SPLIT] ⚡ The incident underscores distinct legal frameworks governing civilian and military driving credentials, where military licenses do not automatically extend to non-tactical private vehicles. item.title: The Digital Pacifier: Hidden Costs of Early Smartphone Exposure
item.dc:creator: Amarjeet Singh
item.description:
When toddlers swipe screens before holding a pencil, what are the hidden developmental costs? A deep dive into AIIMS Delhi's alarming screen time data.
[SPLIT] ⚡ Smartphones are widely deployed as digital pacifiers to manage tantrums and routine household chores. [SPLIT] ⚡ Early exposure to fast-paced digital interfaces correlates with attention regulation issues and delayed speech.
